name: AI Receptionist Backend (Vapi + Google Sheets/Calendar) - Multi-Tenant V3

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Header name/value configured in the credential itself: X-API-Key / <secret>

nodes.name: Validate Business
nodes.notes: [VERIFY] If DateTime is undefined, add: const { DateTime } = require('luxon'); and set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=luxon. booking_enabled now also gates the two package actions.

nodes.name: Route Action
nodes.notes: 7 rule outputs (0-6) + fallback 'Extra Output' (index 7) wired to Finalize Response

nodes.name: Compute Booking Key
nodes.notes: If field labels differ on your version, replace with a Set node: booking_key = {{ $json.key_material.hash('sha256') }}

nodes.name: Insert Event
nodes.notes: Options: Include Response Headers and Status = ON, Never Error = ON. Retry On Fail = OFF.

nodes.name: Build Error Response
nodes.notes: Never exposes raw Google error text; used for classification only

nodes.name: Finalize Response
nodes.notes: MODIFIED: TECH/FAIL/SHAPE and persist now cover check_package_availability and book_package_appointment.

nodes.name: Package Action?
nodes.notes: True for check_package_availability / book_package_appointment. Sits between Read Services and the two Resolve* nodes.

nodes.name: Resolve Package Service
nodes.notes: Assumes exactly ONE session per open calendar day, all at the same session_time. That matches 'split 10 hours into 5 days of 2 hours' — see chat notes for how to relax this.

nodes.name: List Events (Package)
nodes.notes: maxResults raised to 2500 vs the single-day query since this spans up to windowDays days. If nextPageToken still appears for a very busy calendar, this fails safe (see Compute Package Sessions).

nodes.name: Compute Package Sessions
nodes.notes: One session per open day at the fixed session_time from the request. If that exact time never fits, that day is skipped entirely (no per-day time-hunting) — keep this in mind when picking session_time.

nodes.name: Prepare Package Sessions For Booking
nodes.notes: Fans out into N items, one per session. Everything downstream to Insert Package Events runs once per item automatically.

nodes.name: Insert Package Events
nodes.notes: Runs once per session item. neverError=true so application-level failures (4xx/5xx from Google) land on the success output as a normal response and are handled in Interpret Package Insert; onError only catches true network failures, same trade-off as the single-booking Insert Event node.

nodes.name: Interpret Package Insert
nodes.notes: Run once for all items (default Code node mode) — aggregates every session's insert result by matching index against Build Package Event Payload's items.

parameters.jsCode:
const { toDelete, meta, req, res } = $input.first().json;
return toDelete.map(u => ({ json: { meta, req, res, deleteUrl: u } }));

nodes.name: Delete Package Events (Rollback)
nodes.notes: Best-effort cleanup of the sessions that DID succeed when a partial booking fails. Its own outcome doesn't change what the customer is told — either output flows to Finalize After Rollback.
